cases.prompt: I want to run a script every time a new hosting account is created on my CWP server (user and domain passed in). How do I set that up?
expectations: Explains CWP action hooks are PHP files in /usr/local/cwpsrv/htdocs/resources/admin/hooks/account/ named account_new.php defining a function account_new($array)
Notes echo output is not visible so the hook must log to a file
Recommends the hook only validates input and starts a detached worker (setsid, argument array, no shell) so the panel never blocks
Validates username and domain strictly before use
Warns that hook reliability is mixed (account_unsuspend reported not firing) and suggests a reconciling cron
Marks the exact shape of the array (associative vs positional) as unverified or handles both

cases.prompt: After every CWP update my custom admin module menu entry and my modified files disappear. How do I make them survive?
expectations: Mentions /root/.cwp_autoupdate.sh runs after each CWP update and says to append a guarded line rather than overwrite an existing file
Recommends keeping a copy of the module files and menu line outside the CWP tree and re-applying them idempotently (compare before copy, append the 3rdparty.php line only if missing)
Adds a daily cron or systemd timer as a safety net
Handles chattr +i: lifts it only on the paths written and restores it, and notes chattr -R fails on symlinks
Uses flock to avoid overlapping runs and defaults to dry-run with an explicit apply flag

cases.prompt: Create a cron job on a CWP server that runs a PHP maintenance script every 10 minutes, and tell me which PHP binary to use.
expectations: Creates /etc/cron.d/<name> with the user column (root) and an explicit PATH, root-owned and mode 0644
Mentions CWP's own crons call /usr/local/cwp/php71/bin/php -q and that this binary's folder name is historical (modern PHP, check php -v)
For per-user jobs, suggests the user's crontab and the PHP selector path /opt/alt/phpNN/usr/bin/php and testing with su USER -s /bin/bash
Adds flock and logging to a file under /var/log

cases.prompt: Which CWP /scripts helpers should my automation call to restart the panel, rebuild one user's PHP-FPM pool and list all users? Is it fine to just run systemctl restart httpd?
expectations: Lists /scripts/restart_cwpsrv or reload_cwpsrv, phpfpm_rebuild_user_conf, and list_users
Recommends /scripts/restart_httpd or /scripts/cwp_api webservers reload/rebuild_user over raw systemctl, marked as advice rather than a documented rule
Recommends reload over restart and validating the username argument
Suggests /scripts/add_alert to surface failures in the panel
